CustomOrder.title: Made to Measure
CustomOrder.intro: Have something specific in mind? Tell us about your dream piece and share your measurements — our atelier will craft a personalised quote just for you.
CustomOrder.name: Name
measurementGuideLines: Bust: measure around the fullest part of your chest, keeping the tape level.
Waist: measure around the narrowest part of your natural waistline.
Hips: measure around the fullest part of your hips and seat.
Height: measure from the top of your head to the floor, without shoes.
Shoulders: measure across the back from one shoulder seam to the other.
Use a soft tape measure and keep it snug but not tight.
